_comment: Self-contained starter jobs: each creates its own inputs, so none depend on pre-existing fixtures. workdir targets the deployed projects dir (E:\TEMP\HermesTemp\projects). Keep max_turns at 5.

jobs.goal: In the working directory, gather basic environment facts (OS/kernel via `uname -a`, Python version, current directory, and free disk space) and write them to `env-report.md` with a level-1 heading '# Environment Report' and one section per fact. Then print the file contents. Finish with `STATUS: done` once env-report.md exists and contains all four sections.

Create a self-contained Python project in the working directory: `fizzbuzz.py` with a `fizzbuzz(n)` function (returns 'Fizz'/'Buzz'/'FizzBuzz'/str(n)), and `test_fizzbuzz.py` with pytest cases covering 3, 5, 15, and 7. Run `python -m pytest -q` and report the result. Finish with `STATUS: done` only when the tests pass.

Read the harness README at /mnt/e/HermesOutput/buzz-hermes-harness/README.md and write a 5-bullet plain-language summary to `readme-summary.md` in the working directory. Each bullet <= 2 sentences. Finish with `STATUS: done` once readme-summary.md has exactly 5 bullets.
